entries.title: MADiSON

emulation.notes: Use the native PC flat-screen release for the main run.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best flat-screen route because it has the complete game with PC capture/settings flexibility, while no sourced flat-screen platform-exclusive content was identified elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Buy MADiSON on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Play MADiSON VR separately only if the archive needs the VR-specific version.

secondary.exclusive_content: Separate VR adaptation that turns the camera and exploration into a VR presentation.
secondary.what_to_play: Play MADiSON VR after the flat-screen PC run if the VR presentation matters.
secondary.why: MADiSON VR is a VR version for PCVR and PSVR2 rather than a standard flat-screen port.

entries.remaster_caveats: MADiSON VR is a separate VR adaptation, not a replacement for the flat-screen game.

entries.title: MADiSON VR

emulation.notes: Use a supported PC VR headset with the SteamVR release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PCVR presentation with headset-dependent resolution, refresh rate, and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC VR release is the best VR route because it provides the VR adaptation on PC hardware with SteamVR capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy MADiSON VR on Steam and play with a supported PC VR headset. Use PSVR2 only for headset/platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR adaptation of MADiSON; distinct from the 2022 flat-screen game.
